metadata.title: Micron, AMD and other AI stocks fall as the chip sector’s selloff intensifies - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Micron, AMD and other AI stocks fall as the chip sector’s selloff intensifies
Investors are jittery about Nvidia’s upcoming earnings and whether the company will scale back its financing of the AI ecosystem
Cracks in the artificial-intelligence trade are growing deeper, helping extend the broad-based selloff in semiconductor stocks into a third consecutive session Monday.
Shares of Micron Technology MU, Advanced Micro Devices AMD, Intel INTC, Marvell Technology MRVL and Arm Holdings ARM all closed down at least 6% on Monday. Nvidia’s NVDA stock fell 4%, while the PHLX Semiconductor Index SOX ended the day down 5%.
